fields.field_opening_prompt: Our nightly export has been dropping rows for a few customers. Can you find out why and fix it?
fields.field_high_level_goal: Every row reaches the export file exactly once, through both the button and the nightly job. A change to only one of them does not count.
fields.field_codebase_overview: A small web app with a job runner and a shared storage layer. The export code lives in two places that look alike and drift apart over time.
fields.field_rationale_difficulty: The bug shows only above five hundred rows, because the first batch hides the drift. Reading one entry point gives a plausible answer that fails on the other.
